messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- Boreal announced at standup on 2026-03-13 a deploy freeze for Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-13]
- The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down. [valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-06]
- Ledger only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-28]
- As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly. [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Team Dune observed on 2025-12-08 that Ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- Ledger is pinned to Postgres 14 as of 2025-05-30. [constraint; valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- Billing-api has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Ledger is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the latency issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011. [valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- Ledger is owned by Cinder as of 2026-04-29, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-04-29; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Ledger is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the disk usage jump instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- The Postgres 14 pin on Ledger lifts when the partitioning work finishes. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- Team Dune noticed on 2025-09-18 that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-09-18 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]

Question: What is the deploy window of the service that the ledger depends on?

message.content: Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.

The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.

Answer: Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
